candidates.description: This vector represents chemical elements, ions, and molecular radicals commonly found in inorganic chemistry.
These German verb stems and prefixes represent common actions, processes, and states used in technical or formal descriptions.
These tokens represent common punctuation marks and open-parentheses symbols used in text formatting.
German prepositions indicating spatial, temporal, or logical relationships.
This feature vector activates on scientific, technological, and medical combining forms and suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on three-digit numbers in the low two-hundreds range.
This vector represents units of measurement and numerical percentages.
This vector represents German pronominal adverbs and common grammatical prefixes, conjunctions, and inflections.
This feature vector represents common German and English adverbial and adjectival modifiers indicating degree, manner, or extent.
This feature activates strongly on tokens containing the letter "x" or the "ox"/hex" sub-word patterns.
